reader_test.decision: The five-reader approval gate is removed. The updated site ships without a reader test. No replacement approval step is added.
reader_test.rule: Five distinct unfamiliar human readers, with at least four passing each of three tasks (homepage subject and contact within 20 seconds, the Missing Column, Counted film in one sentence, one activation of the proof link), recorded in publication/readers.json before scripts/publication_gate.py would let the deployment job publish.
reader_test.in_force: 2026-10-17 (2949acd) to 2026-11-13. The last deployment that published is 50b2898 on 2026-10-17. Eleven pushes to main from 506a8fa to c1642d6 stopped at the deployment gate; from 7764a42 onward this rule was the only blocker.
removed: the readers check, --bind and --template in scripts/publication_gate.py
reader_test.kept: publication/reader-test-kit.md, marked retired, as the record of what the rule asked. The title and phone-film checks still gate the deployment job, as do the claim, reproduction and deployed-site jobs.
reader_test.not_changed: The deployment step name in .github/workflows/verify.yml and one docstring sentence in scripts/verification_manifest.py still mention reader evidence. Both are trust-root files under security/evidence-policy.json and change only through a separate migration.
non_claims: Shipping without the test does not establish that unfamiliar readers understand the site.
The film cold-viewer rule for feed releases (campaigns.yaml, distribution/launch-units.yaml) is a separate rule and is not changed by this decision.
